ability.zh: 吸取、保持与推出的有限行程计量

params.zh: 容量、行程和通道按HLD/HMD配置确认
params.en: Confirm capacity, stroke and channels for the HLD/HMD configuration

params.zh: 工作剂量、压力与通讯按具体型号确认
params.en: Confirm dose, pressure and communication by model

advantage.zh: 适合需要完整吸排动作的样本、试剂和稀释任务，结合阀路、接收位置和补液时点选择。
advantage.en: Suitable candidates for sample, reagent and dilution duties requiring controlled aspiration and dispense, selected with valves, receiver and refill timing.

solves.zh: 重点核查实际交付、首剂、气泡和通道差异；容量与步进分辨率不代表最小可靠剂量。
solves.en: Check actual delivery, first dose, bubbles and channel differences; capacity and resolution do not establish minimum reliable dose.

ability.zh: 样本、试剂和稀释液的有限行程计量
ability.en: Finite-stroke metering of sample, reagent and diluent

params.zh: EA容量50 μL–20 mL；SM 50 μL–1 mL；TM 50–500 μL
params.en: EA capacity 50 μL–20 mL; SM 50 μL–1 mL; TM 50–500 μL

params.zh: EA规定条件下满量程准确性/重复性≤0.5%
params.en: EA full-stroke accuracy/repeatability ≤0.5% under specified conditions

params.zh: SM准确性按实际配置确认；满量程重复性≤0.5%
params.en: Confirm SM accuracy by configuration; full-stroke repeatability ≤0.5%

params.zh: EA/SM预计500万次：纯水、常温、50 kPa背压
params.en: EA/SM expected life 5,000,000 cycles: pure water, room temperature, 50 kPa backpressure

advantage.zh: 按常用剂量、材料、阀路及安装空间比较EA、SM和TM。小剂量交付与补液恢复需在接收端验证。
advantage.en: Compare EA, SM and TM by working dose, materials, valves and space. Validate small doses and refill recovery at the receiver.

solves.zh: 针对剂量波动、闲置首剂、气泡及残液设计动作与清洗；不作为高压色谱主泵替代。
solves.en: Address dose variation, idle first dose, bubbles and residue through motion and washing; these are not high-pressure LC mobile-phase replacements.

name.zh: 采样针 / 洗针 / 混合部件

ability.zh: 容器接液位置、吸液与清洗几何

params.zh: 针径、长度、端部、表面与接口按项目确认
params.en: Confirm diameter, length, end, surface and interface by project

params.zh: 液位检测、清洗与动作需配合验证
params.en: Validate level sensing, wash and motion together

advantage.zh: 按样本、容器、吸取高度和清洗覆盖设计；几何、泵程序与运动共同决定接收结果。
advantage.en: Design for specimen, vessel, aspiration height and wash coverage; geometry, pump program and motion jointly determine results.

solves.zh: 评价挂液、凝块、残余样本、吸附和携带污染，定制结构需按完整流程验证。
solves.en: Evaluate retained droplets, clots, reserve volume, adsorption and carryover with the complete workflow.

ability.zh: 支路通断、隔离与两路切换
ability.en: Branch shutoff, isolation and two-path selection

params.zh: 压差、流向、常态和接液材料按型号确认
params.en: Confirm differential pressure, direction, normal state and wetted materials by model

params.zh: 线圈占空、响应和安装温度按实际工况评估
params.en: Evaluate coil duty, response and temperature under installed conditions

advantage.zh: 按端口状态、介质、压力及失电去向选择配置，阀响应与液体实际到达时间分别确认。
advantage.en: Select by port state, liquid, pressure and de-energized destination; confirm valve response and liquid arrival separately.

solves.zh: 核查误通、泄漏、热负载及共享段残留，避免把系列汇总范围当作每个型号的能力。
solves.en: Check wrong connections, leakage, thermal duty and shared residue rather than assigning a series aggregate to every model.

ability.zh: 多源或多目的地的路径选择

params.zh: 标准10 / 16 / 24通道配置
params.en: Standard 10 / 16 / 24-port configurations

params.zh: MRV3规格耐压0.7 MPa
params.en: MRV3 specified pressure rating 0.7 MPa

params.zh: 通径、内容积、接口与材料按对应型号核对
params.en: Check bore, internal volume, interface and materials by model

params.zh: 规格寿命100万次；实际介质/动作需评估
params.en: Specified life 1,000,000 cycles; evaluate actual liquid and switching duty

advantage.zh: 集中选择样本、试剂或洗液来源，以完整端口状态、共享体积和置换要求确定通数与配置。
advantage.en: Select sources centrally using the complete state table, shared volume and purge requirement to choose ports and configuration.

solves.zh: 降低路径管理复杂度，仍需验证误通、泄漏与切换后残留；多端口不等于多通道同时加液。
solves.en: Simplify routing while validating wrong connections, leakage and residue; multiple ports do not mean simultaneous independent dispensing.

ability.zh: 软管路径的外部夹闭控制

params.zh: 管材、OD/壁厚、压力及夹闭寿命按配置确认
params.en: Confirm tube material, OD/wall, pressure and closure life by configuration

params.zh: 关闭泄漏和开启阻力按安装状态验证
params.en: Validate closed leakage and open resistance after installation

advantage.zh: 液体主要接触软管，可用于减少阀体接液并方便更换；需把接头和整条管路一起评估。
advantage.en: Liquid contacts the tubing, reducing valve-body contact and aiding replacement; evaluate fittings and the entire path together.

solves.zh: 关注管材疲劳、夹闭失效与维护；封闭或无菌能力由完整路径和操作验证。
solves.en: Address fatigue, incomplete closure and service; closed or aseptic capability requires path and process validation.

ability.zh: 清洗供液、补液与适用的液体转移
ability.en: Wash supply, replenishment and suitable liquid transfer

params.zh: DPL30 / DPL60系列自由流量300 / 600 mL/min级
params.en: DPL30 / DPL60 free-flow references in the 300 / 600 mL/min class

params.zh: 流量与压力按实际安装曲线和配置核查
params.en: Check flow and pressure on the installed curve and configuration

params.zh: 接液材料、温度、吸程和运行周期按型号确认
params.en: Confirm wetted materials, temperature, suction and duty by model

advantage.zh: 适合液体供液候选；按阀、管路、洗头与容器阻力确定实际工作点，含气抽吸单独比较。
advantage.en: Evaluate for liquid supply at the installed valve, tubing, head and reservoir resistance; compare mixed-air aspiration separately.

solves.zh: 验证供液体积/时间、预充和补液恢复，自由流量与最大压力不同时代表工作点。
solves.en: Verify supply volume/time, prime and refill recovery; free flow and maximum pressure do not describe one duty point.

ability.zh: 连接几何、密封和接液材料匹配
ability.en: Connection geometry, sealing and wetted-material matching

params.zh: ID/OD、长度、螺纹和端口几何按路径确认
params.en: Confirm ID/OD, length, threads and port geometry for the path

params.zh: 材料、压力、扫掠体积与维护一起核对
params.en: Check material, pressure, swept volume and service together

advantage.zh: 将泵、阀、针和传感器连成可维护路径，按介质、压力与残液预算选择，而不只按相同螺纹连接。
advantage.en: Build serviceable paths between pumps, valves, probes and sensors using liquid, pressure and residue budgets rather than matching threads alone.

solves.zh: 验证泄漏、间隙、吸附、压力损失和维护恢复，材料名单不等于介质兼容保证。
solves.en: Verify leakage, gaps, adsorption, pressure loss and service recovery; material lists do not guarantee compatibility.

ability.zh: 液路信号采集与控制器异常判定
ability.en: Fluid-state signals for controller fault decisions

params.zh: ABD透明管OD 1.6–6.4 mm；检测条件按管材/液体确认
params.en: ABD transparent-tube OD 1.6–6.4 mm; confirm tubing/liquid conditions

params.zh: ABD气泡/液体检测宽度>0.8 mm；响应6 ms
params.en: ABD detectable bubble/liquid width >0.8 mm; response 6 ms

params.zh: PDM5量程、压力参考与配置按确认资料核对
params.en: Confirm PDM5 range, pressure reference and configuration against approved data

params.zh: PDM5默认采样37.5 Hz，最高可调100 Hz
params.en: PDM5 default sampling 37.5 Hz, adjustable up to 100 Hz

advantage.zh: 气泡与压力是不同检测能力。按目标故障、位置、液体和时间窗定义阈值，选择相应检测模块。
advantage.en: Bubble and pressure are different measurements. Define thresholds for target faults, location, liquid and timing before choosing modules.

solves.zh: 减少空吸、堵塞或气泡导致的流程异常；控制器和方法仍需判断剂量、样本与结果有效性。
solves.en: Support detection of empty aspiration, blockage or bubbles; controller and method still determine dose, specimen and result validity.

ability.zh: 有条件的防回流和颗粒保护

params.zh: 开启压、泄漏、孔径、材料与压降按型号确认
params.en: Confirm cracking pressure, leakage, pore size, materials and pressure drop by model

params.zh: 目标组分、容积和维护按具体方法评估
params.en: Evaluate target fraction, hold-up and maintenance by method

advantage.zh: 先明确保护对象和分析方法，再设置位置与更换流程，新增阻力计入泵阀工作点。
advantage.en: Define protection target and analytical method before placement and service, including added resistance in the operating point.

solves.zh: 防回流或过滤不单独证明无菌；过滤可能改变目标组分，需检查回收和代表性。
solves.en: Backflow control or filtration does not prove sterility; filtration may alter the target fraction and requires recovery and representativeness checks.

ability.zh: 一次性吸头的样本转移与配液
ability.en: Disposable-tip sample transfer and liquid preparation

params.zh: SMTP2 / SMTP4容量与驱动按具体配置核对
params.en: Check SMTP2 / SMTP4 capacity and drive by configuration

params.zh: 实际液量、液体类别与吸头密封联合验证
params.en: Validate working volume, liquid class and tip seal together

advantage.zh: 供一次性吸头架构比较，配合Z轴、液面和接收位置设置吸排速度、空气间隔与动作。
advantage.en: Compare for disposable-tip architectures with Z motion, liquid level and receiver-specific speeds, air gaps and motion.

solves.zh: 核查挂液、空吸和吸头密封；标称容量或步进分辨率不证明最小可靠移液量。
solves.en: Check retained droplets, empty aspiration and sealing; capacity and drive resolution do not establish minimum reliable volume.

ability.zh: 适用的重复剂量、持续供液或双路比例
ability.en: Suitable repeated dosing, sustained supply or two-stream proportioning

params.zh: 每转排量、每次剂量与每分钟流量分别定义
params.en: Define displacement/revolution, dose/event and flow/minute separately

params.zh: 介质、转速、背压、预充及恢复按任务验证
params.en: Validate liquid, speed, backpressure, prime and recovery for the duty

advantage.zh: 在真实液体和工作点下比较重复分配或辅助连续供液，双路配比还需验证实际混合比例。
advantage.en: Compare repeated or sustained auxiliary duties with actual liquids and operating points; paired dosing also requires actual mixture verification.

solves.zh: 关注首剂、滑移、残留、结晶与长期输出；方法适配需验证，不作为所有加液任务必选。
solves.en: Assess first dose, slip, residue, crystallization and long-run output; method suitability requires validation.

ability.zh: 进口含空气/气液混合的抽吸
ability.en: Aspiration with air or gas-liquid mixtures at the inlet

params.zh: DPGL800适用于气体/气液混合，不适合100%液体
params.en: DPGL800 is for gas/gas-liquid mixtures, not 100% liquid

params.zh: 单头6 L/min是空载气体流量
params.en: 6 L/min per head is no-load gas flow

params.zh: 实际排液、空气比例、泡沫和吸程联合验证
params.en: Validate drainage, air fraction, foam and suction together

advantage.zh: 可比较洗站或适用混合介质抽吸；与供液泵、废液瓶、通气和满液联锁共同设计。
advantage.en: Compare for wash stations or suitable mixed-media aspiration, coordinated with supply, waste vessel, venting and full-level interlocks.

solves.zh: 气体流量不代表液体排废能力，按峰值来液与吸入口状态评价完整抽排循环。
solves.en: Gas flow is not a liquid-drain rating; evaluate the full aspiration cycle for peak liquid arrival and inlet state.

ability.zh: 受压进样路径和压力区域切换
ability.en: Pressurized injection paths and pressure-zone switching

params.zh: 各阀状态的端口连接与压力按型号核查
params.en: Check port connections and pressures in every state by model

params.zh: 定量环、接头、材料与切换动作一起验证
params.en: Validate loop, fittings, materials and switching together

advantage.zh: 用于具体高压切换候选，按进样架构和实际压力选择，低压计量装置是否隔离由系统确定。
advantage.en: Evaluate for defined high-pressure switching, selecting by architecture and exposure; the system determines metering-path isolation.

solves.zh: 核查受压端口误通、泄漏、残留和切换瞬态，普通多通阀不能替代压力核查。
solves.en: Check wrong connections, leakage, residue and switching transients at pressurized ports.
